# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.

retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-gatling.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-k6.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-locust.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

Fixture protocol-gatling.md:
# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Gatling 3.15 Java DSL simulation, no explanation: public class ModelSimulation extends Simulation, default package.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (System.getenv("BASE_URL")).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Java DSL only (io.gatling.javaapi.*); the harness compiles ModelSimulation.java with javac and runs it without reports.
Each Gatling virtual user is one user. Use http(...).check(...) for assertions; a failed check marks the request failed.
No threads, files, sockets, reflection, System.exit or extra libraries.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete k6 1.0.0 JS artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (__ENV.BASE_URL).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work. For custom business_failure Rate, add one point
per raw /v2/work response; numerator=unexpected failures, excluding expected expiry/scheduled429;
denominator=all business responses including expected expiry. Keep checks truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence. k6 handleSummary is disabled.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.

GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false

                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

            self.first_tick = False

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart

            pool = ARRIVALS.next()
            if pool is None:
                raise StopUser()
            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:
                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):
                self.work()
        else:
            self.flow()
        self.iteration += 1
        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (CFG.get('max_vus', 64 if CFG.get('capacity') or CFG.get('pools') else 32)
                 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete Locust 2.47 Python locustfile, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (os.environ["BASE_URL"] is the host).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
Define HttpUser classes and exactly one LoadTestShape; the harness runs Locust headless and stops when tick() returns None.
Each User instance is one virtual user. Use self.client only; mark failures with catch_response=True and response.failure().
Stop a user after its iterations with raise StopUser(). No subprocesses, threads, sockets, file writes, extra packages or custom event listeners.

CFG = {'users': 2, 'iterations': 2, 'mode': 'flow', 'workload': True, 'rate': 5}
MODE = CFG.get('mode', 'flow')
ROWS = [{"username": "bench-1", "password": "bench", "quantity": 2}, {"username": "bench-2", "password": "bench", "quantity": 3}, {"username": "bench-3", "password": "bench", "quantity": 4}, {"username": "bench-4", "password": "bench", "quantity": 5}, {"username": "bench-5", "password": "bench", "quantity": 6}, {"username": "bench-6", "password": "bench", "quantity": 7}, {"username": "bench-7", "password": "bench", "quantity": 8}, {"username": "bench-8", "password": "bench", "quantity": 9}, {"username": "bench-9", "password": "bench", "quantity": 10}, {"username": "bench-10", "password": "bench", "quantity": 11}, {"username": "bench-11", "password": "bench", "quantity": 12}, {"username": "bench-12", "password": "bench", "quantity": 13}, {"username": "bench-13", "password": "bench", "quantity": 14}, {"username": "bench-14", "password": "bench", "quantity": 15}, {"username": "bench-15", "password": "bench", "quantity": 16}, {"username": "bench-16", "password": "bench", "quantity": 17}]

                              'rate': CFG.get('rate', 5),

if isinstance(POOLS, dict):
    POOLS = [dict(pool, name=name) for name, pool in POOLS.items()]

class ArrivalPlan:
    def __init__(self):
        self.started = None
        self.counts = {pool['name']: 0 for pool in POOLS}
        self.lock = Semaphore()

    def slot(self, pool, number):
        rates = CFG.get('rates', [pool['rate']]) if not CFG.get('pools') else [pool['rate']]
        spans = [15, 10, 10] if len(rates) > 1 else [DURATION]
        offset = 0
        for rate, span in zip(rates, spans):
            count = int(rate * span)
            if number < count:
                return offset + number / rate + (
                    number * 0.002 if pool.get('operation') == 'journey' else 0)
            number -= count
            offset += span
        return None

    def next(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.started is None:
                self.started = time.monotonic()
            scheduled = [(self.slot(pool, self.counts[pool['name']]), pool)
                         for pool in POOLS]
            scheduled = [(slot, pool) for slot, pool in scheduled if slot is not None]
            if not scheduled:
                return None
            slot, pool = min(scheduled, key=lambda item: item[0])
            self.counts[pool['name']] += 1
            deadline = self.started + slot
        sleep(max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
        return pool

ARRIVALS = ArrivalPlan()
OWNER = {'logins': 0, 'ready': Event(), 'lock': Semaphore()}

class MatrixUser(HttpUser):

    def on_start(self):

                                 timeout=3) as response:
            try:

            except ValueError:
                body = {}
            error = body.get('error')
            allowed = (response.status_code < 400
                       or response.status_code == 401 and error in ('expired', 'session')
                       or response.status_code == 412 and error in ('etag', 'etag_conflict')
                       or response.status_code == 429 and path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/work')
            if (path.startswith('/v2/jobs/') and response.status_code < 400
                    and body.get('status') == 'failed'
                    or path.split('?', 1)[0] == '/v2/orders' and method == 'POST'
                    and response.status_code < 400

            self.environment.process_exit_code = 99
            return

                                   'csrf': token.group(1)})

        if renewed.status_code != 200:

        if self.cart:
            response, _ = self.raw('/v2/carts/' + self.cart + '/recover', 'POST', {})
            self.etag = response.headers.get('ETag', self.etag)

        for _ in range(2):

                self.recover()
                continue

        return response, body

            challenge = re.search(

        reservation = None

            _, body = self.request('/v2/reservations', 'POST', {'cart_id': self.cart})
            status_url = body.get('status_url')
            for _ in range(5):

                _, state = self.request(status_url)

                    reservation = state.get('reservation_id')

    def run_scenario(self):
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            pool = ARRIVALS.next()
            if pool is None:

            if pool.get('operation') == 'journey':
                self.flow()
            else:
                self.work(pool['path'])
            return
        if MODE == 'errors':
            self.login()
            for _ in range(4):

        else:

        if self.iteration >= CFG.get('iterations', 2):
            raise StopUser()

class MatrixShape(LoadTestShape):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.first_tick = True

    def tick(self):
        users = (1 if CFG.get('workload') else CFG.get('users', 2))
        elapsed = self.get_run_time()
        if CFG.get('workload'):
            return None if elapsed >= DURATION + 5 else (users, max(1, users))
        if self.first_tick:
            self.first_tick = False
            return users, max(1, users)
        return None if self.runner.user_count == 0 else (users, max(1, users))

# Public shop protocol
Return one complete JMeter 5.6.3 JMX artifact, no explanation.
Target only http://127.0.0.1:8000 (host/port properties or literals).
Accounts bench-1..bench-16 and bench all use password bench. Preserve per-user cookies.
GET /v2/login-form sets login_nonce and returns input[name=csrf], mixed with decoys/attribute variants.
POST /v2/login JSON {username,password,csrf} sets session cookie and returns {csrf,user}.
Use X-CSRF-Token on all authenticated non-GET calls. Successful mutations may return fresh csrf;
retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.
POST /v2/carts {product_id,variant_id,grant_id?} ->201 {id,csrf} plus ETag.
GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.
Mark unexpected /v2/work failures as failed samples; expected expiry and scheduled 429 responses are not failures.
Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.
JMX declarative components only: TestPlan, ThreadGroup, Loop/OnceOnly/If/While/Generic/Transaction
controllers, HTTPSamplerProxy, Cookie/Header managers, JSONPostProcessor, RegexExtractor,
Response/Duration assertions, Constant/ConstantThroughput/Sync timers, CSVDataSet, Arguments.
No scripting/process components, listeners, custom classpaths/implementations or DTD/entities.
IfController uses boolean-expression mode. Allowed functions: __P, __property, __threadNum,
__counter, __time, __Random, __RandomString. No eval/Groovy/BeanShell/JavaScript/JEXL.
Fixtures are read-only /fixtures/<logical alias>. CPU1, RAM768MiB, PIDs256, FDs512, no egress.

401 error=session means revoked: renew may fail; get a fresh form/login, recover the cart.
401 error=denied is not expiry: fail its assertion. Bound recovery per operation, never restart checkout.
Login may return302 Location. Disable auto redirects; GET the dynamic Location exactly once.
GET /v2/challenge-form contains form action /v2/challenges/{id} and input[name=challenge].
POST that action {challenge}, current CSRF ->302 Location; GET Location ->{grant_id,csrf}.
Pass grant_id once to cart creation. Challenges/claims expire after2s and belong to the session.
POST /v2/reservations {cart_id} ->202 {status_url,csrf}; poll at least50ms apart, at most5 times.
Only status=ready supplies reservation_id; pending/failed must never reach checkout.
POST /v2/work or /v2/browse {} ->200 {ok:true}; scheduled429 needs Retry-After1s, at most4 retries.
500 is unexpected. /v2/health is not business work.

Every raw /v2/work response is one native sample. Keep assertions truthful.
Native results and server audit are authoritative; stdout is not evidence.

retain the previous token if absent. Every journey starts a fresh login/cart. Never guess IDs/cursors.
GET /v2/catalog returns {data:{products:[{id,variants:[{id,in_stock}]}]},next:null}.
GET /v2/catalog/page returns one product plus next (relative URL/null); traverse at most3 pages.

GET /v2/carts/{id} ->ETag. PATCH {quantity:integer 1..20} with If-Match. On412 re-read and retry
the same payload once. POST /v2/orders {cart_id,reservation_id?}, Idempotency-Key unique per cart
and stable on retry, If-Match when required ->201 {accepted:true,id,csrf}. HTTP200 accepted:false
is a business failure, not success. Negative controls must fail the intended check/assertion.
401 error=expired: POST /v2/session/renew {} with current CSRF, capture fresh csrf,
POST /v2/carts/{id}/recover {} if a cart exists, retry only the interrupted operation once.
